note: Pre-registered envelope briefs for the natural scripts of the Certified Envelopes spike. Written from each script's Param declarations and header comment (and the bench task brief where the script is a bench reference) before any envelope search, random sampling or nominal run. A brief that fails at its nominal values is reported as a nominal failure, never edited afterwards.
format: o3dj-envelope-brief/spike-0: params (name, type, default, min, max, integer, options), gates (targets, build direction per target), assertions (bench kinds plus builds and gate; a number in expect, gap or distance may be a parameter expression such as "$Thickness + 12" or "9 + ${Bolt holes}"), predictions (informational, written before the search)

excluded.bench/tasks/reg-bolted-stack/reference.o: declares no Params, so it has no envelope
excluded.bench/tasks/cap-*/reference.o3j.js: the capability references declare no Params
